noDummyNote: There is NO DUMMY — even your partner's hand stays concealed to the end.
ladderTitle: Bidding order (level-1 trick value in brackets)
ladderNote: Spades are the LOWEST and no trump the highest — the reverse of bridge. Each level above 1 adds 10 to the trick value.
gameTargetNote: A game is {{n}} below the line; two games take the rubber.
bidNotice: Pick a level (level N contracts for 6 + N tricks) and a denomination.
playNotice: Following suit is compulsory; only legal cards can be chosen.
bothScoreNote: BOTH sides score the tricks they took — the defenders too, even when the contract was made.
honourLine: Honours: team 0 +{{t0}} / team 1 +{{t1}} (trump A K Q J 10, from three or more)
aceLine: Aces: team 0 +{{t0}} / team 1 +{{t1}} (the majority holder takes them all)
penaltyLine: Penalty: team 0 +{{t0}} / team 1 +{{t1}} (undertricks x level x 500)

tutorial.players: Each seat's team and tricks. There is no dummy, so no hand is exposed.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Following suit is compulsory, so illegal cards cannot be chosen.
